description: What if artificial intelligence could step out of the screen and into the real world? This is not just about smarter conversation. This is Embodied Intelligence. Imagine a robot that does not just calculate a chess move, but physically makes it. Not every smart robot qualifies, so what changes when AI gains a physical form? On the show: Steve, Fei Fei & Yushun
classificationReason: The episode directly explains embodied intelligence and how AI systems gain physical form through robots.
qualityReason: A focused interview/report on embodied intelligence that explains distinctions from automation, deployment examples, data and hardware constraints, current limitations, and practical tradeoffs.
